facts.evidence: **Revenue:** $17.2 billion, up 1% year-over-year (YoY), with constant currency growth of 4-5%. (The $17.2B / +1% reported figures are right; the appended constant-currency clause is full-year guidance, flagged separately in Part 2.)
**Diluted Earnings Per Share:** $2.27, down 3% YoY. (Release shows the year/year change as (2), i.e. down 2 percent.)

**High-Growth Portfolio:** Software segment, particularly Red Hat, the Watsonx portfolio, HashiCorp, and Confluent, grew 5% with strong performance. (The +5% for Software is correct; the brief omits the $7.8 billion revenue figure and that Software is the largest segment.)
**Revenue Growth:** Full-year constant currency revenue growth expected in the range of 4-5%. (The currency-neutral-to-growth detail is omitted but nothing is misstated.)
**Free Cash Flow:** Expected to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year.
**Free Cash Flow:** $2.5 billion, down $0.3 billion YoY.

claims.claim: Second-quarter revenue was $17.2 billion.
claims.note: Income statement summary and comparative results ($17,162M).

claims.claim: Second-quarter revenue was up 1% year over year.
claims.note: Year/Year revenue change of 1 in the Q2 summary.

claims.claim: Second-quarter revenue grew 4-5% at constant currency.
claims.note: The 4-5% constant currency figure is full-year 2026 guidance, not a reported second-quarter result. The release gives no total-company constant currency growth rate for the quarter.

claims.claim: Second-quarter gross profit was $9.9 billion.
claims.note: Summary shows GAAP gross profit of 9.9B ($9,907M).

claims.claim: Gross profit was down 1% year over year.
claims.note: Year/Year gross profit change of (1).

claims.claim: Second-quarter pre-tax income was $2.5 billion.
claims.note: GAAP pre-tax income from continuing operations of 2.5B ($2,479M).

claims.claim: Pre-tax income was down 5% year over year.
claims.note: Year/Year pre-tax income change of (5).

claims.claim: Second-quarter net income was $2.2 billion.
claims.note: GAAP net income of 2.2B ($2,165M).

claims.claim: Net income was down 9% year over year.
claims.note: The release shows net income down 1% year over year. The (0.9) in the summary row is the pre-tax income margin change in points, not a net income percentage; $2,165M vs $2,194M is about a 1% decline.

claims.claim: Second-quarter diluted earnings per share was $2.27.
claims.note: GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations of $2.27.

claims.claim: Diluted earnings per share was down 3% year over year.
claims.note: The release shows the diluted EPS year/year change as (2), i.e. down 2% ($2.27 vs $2.31).

claims.claim: The Software segment grew 5% in the second quarter.
claims.note: Software revenues of $7.8 billion, up 5 percent. Note the brief's phrasing implies Red Hat, watsonx, HashiCorp and Confluent each grew 5%; the release only gives 5% for the Software segment (Red Hat is separately cited at up 11 percent).

claims.claim: Red Hat, the watsonx portfolio, HashiCorp and Confluent are high-growth areas of the software business delivering strong performance.
claims.note: Named in the High-Growth Portfolio section as continuing to deliver strong performance.

claims.claim: Distributed Infrastructure grew 37% in the second quarter.
claims.note: Infrastructure segment detail: Distributed Infrastructure up 37 percent.

claims.claim: Distributed Infrastructure has an order backlog of nearly $500 million.
claims.note: The release attributes the nearly $500 million backlog specifically to Power and Storage (within Distributed Infrastructure), not to the whole Distributed Infrastructure line; the figure itself is correct.

claims.claim: Consulting revenue was flat year over year.
claims.note: Consulting revenues of $5.3 billion, flat.

claims.claim: Consulting revenue was up 1% at constant currency.
claims.note: Stated in the segment results.

claims.claim: The company expects full-year constant currency revenue growth in the range of 4-5%.
claims.note: Full-Year 2026 Expectations; repeated in the brief's Segments and Outlook sections.

claims.claim: The company expects free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year over year.
claims.note: Full-Year 2026 Expectations; the brief does not say 'full-year' in the Segments bullet but the Outlook context is correct.

claims.claim: IBM is accelerating changes to its go-to-market model.
claims.note: Stated in Operational Focus Areas, via expanded sales coverage across thousands of additional clients.

claims.claim: IBM is investing in AI and quantum computing.
claims.note: Release cites AI investment and more than $10 billion in quantum over the next five years.

claims.claim: Second-quarter net cash from operating activities was $2.6 billion, up $0.9 billion year over year.
claims.note: Cash Flow and Balance Sheet section.

claims.claim: Second-quarter free cash flow was $2.5 billion, down $0.3 billion year over year.
claims.note: Cash Flow and Balance Sheet section ($2,540M vs $2,845M).

claims.claim: IBM ended the quarter with $8.2 billion of cash, restricted cash and marketable securities, down $6.3 billion from year-end 2025.
claims.note: Stated verbatim in the release.

claims.claim: IBM invested $10.5 billion in acquisitions year to date.
claims.note: Release says $10.5 billion in acquisitions this year; cash flow statement shows $10,480M for the six months.

claims.claim: IBM faced revenue headwinds late in the second quarter.
claims.note: CFO quote: 'Although we faced revenue headwinds late in the second quarter...'
